input.prompt:
Continuing Milestone 5 research (1974/75 English First Division week-10 match dataset, cutoff Sat 25 Oct 1974 inclusive — see earlier fork's report in this conversation for full context). Read-only research only, do not write any files.

Four clubs currently have NO independent primary source for their matches in the 17 Aug – 25 Oct 1974 window — their results were only reconstructed from opponents' Wikipedia pages, never corroborated by anything from the club's own side: **Sheffield United, Burnley, Coventry City, Tottenham Hotspur**. None of these four have a Wikipedia "1974–75 [Club] F.C. season" article.

Known failed attempts (don't repeat these exact URLs expecting a different result via WebFetch — they 403'd or errored):
- 11v11.com team-matches pages for all 4 clubs (403)
- worldfootball.net schedule/team pages (403)
- uptheclarets.com/fixtures-results/197475-results (403, Burnley's own archive)
- thfcdb.com/seasons/1974-75/matches (403, Tottenham's own archive)
- footballsite.co.uk Sheffield United / Wolves / Tottenham pages (TLS cert errors)
- soccerway.com team pages (loaded but returned wrong/modern-era content)

YOUR TASK — two strategies, try both:

1. **Wayback Machine bypass**: For each of the above URLs that 403'd or errored (11v11.com team pages for these 4 clubs, worldfootball.net team schedule pages, uptheclarets.com results page, thfcdb.com matches page, footballsite.co.uk club pages), try fetching an archived snapshot via web.archive.org instead — e.g. `https://web.archive.org/web/2023/https://www.11v11.com/teams/burnley/tab/matches/season/1975/` (try a few different snapshot years if one 404s; web.archive.org will often redirect to the nearest available snapshot, or list available snapshots via `http://archive.org/wayback/available?url=<url>`). This is a good way around bot-blocking since archive.org typically isn't blocked by WebFetch itself.

2. **Find genuinely new sources**: search for other historical-football-stats sites that might independently cover these 4 clubs for 1974-75 with dated match results — candidates to try: thestatcat.co.uk, statto.com, footballsite.co.uk (via Wayback if direct fails), fchd.info, londonhearts.com, playupliverpool.com-style fan archive sites for the other clubs, statsengine or similar. Also try each club's own official site history pages, and Wikipedia's *general* club history article (not the season-specific one) which sometimes has a "1974–75 season" subsection.

For each of the 4 clubs, the goal is to find their FULL set of league match results (opponent, venue, date, score) from 17 Aug – 25 Oct 1974, ideally from a source independent of whatever page originally supplied that data via the opponent's page. This is also how you can resolve the outstanding "suspected duplicate" ambiguities: Coventry (Derby v Coventry, 21 vs 27 Aug) and Tottenham (Man City v Tottenham, 21 vs 28 Aug) are 2 of the 4 clubs you're sourcing, so a genuine independent source for their full match list would settle those too.

Report back:
- For each of the 4 clubs: what source(s) you found (with exact URLs) and what matches they show for the window, or confirmation that nothing worked.
- Whether the Wayback Machine approach got you past any of the specific blocked URLs listed above (say which ones worked and which didn't).
- Specifically resolve if possible: was there really a Coventry match on both 21 Aug AND 27 Aug (vs Derby), and a Tottenham match on both 21 Aug AND 28 Aug (vs Man City)? Or was one of those a data error?
- Any new discrepancies found vs. the existing compiled list.

Be thorough but don't loop forever on a dead end — if a strategy clearly isn't working after a few genuine attempts, move to the next one.

content.text:
**Directive:** Find alternate/independent sources for Sheffield United, Burnley, Coventry City, and Tottenham Hotspur's 1974-75 matches (17 Aug–25 Oct 1974 window), try Wayback Machine bypass for previously-blocked URLs, and resolve the 3 suspected-duplicate fixture pairs. Read-only, no files written.

## Headline result: the 3 "suspected duplicates" are all genuine matches, not errors

Independently confirmed all three via new sources:
- **Derby County v Coventry City**: 21 Aug 1974 (Derby home) **1–1**, and 27 Aug 1974 (Coventry home) **1–1** — confirmed via svenskafans.com ("Omgång 2 spelades 21 augusti: Derby – Coventry 1–1"; "Omgång 4 ... spelades 27 augusti: Coventry City – Derby 1–1"), matches the originally compiled data exactly.
- **Manchester City v Tottenham Hotspur**: 21 Aug 1974 (Man City home, Maine Road) **1–0** (Hartford), and 28 Aug 1974 (Tottenham home, White Hart Lane, att. 20,079) **1–2** (Bell, Peters, Booth) — confirmed via 11v11.com match-report pages surfaced through WebSearch.
- **Leeds United v QPR**: 21 Aug 1974 (Leeds home, att. 31,497) **0–1**, and 27 Aug 1974 (QPR home, att. 24,965) **1–1** (Yorath) — confirmed via WebSearch.

**Why this pattern exists**: found a 4th matching case — Burnley v Chelsea also played twice within a week (21 Aug away 3–3, 27 Aug home 1–2, via clarets-mad.co.uk and bounder.friardale.co.uk, cross-confirming each other). This reflects a real English football fixture-list convention of that era: clubs were paired for reciprocal home/away fixtures within days of each other during the season's opening weeks. Not a data artifact — safe to keep both matches in every one of these pairs.

## The 2 previously-unresolved matches: both resolved

- **Coventry City v Burnley, 31 Aug 1974**: actually **Burnley 3–0 Coventry City** (Burnley home, not Coventry as originally assumed — venue was previously unconfirmed). Source: clarets-mad.co.uk, Burnley's own historical match archive, directly fetchable.
- **Tottenham Hotspur v Burnley, 5 Oct 1974**: **Tottenham Hotspur 2–3 Burnley** (Tottenham home). Independently confirmed by clarets-mad.co.uk ("5 October 1974 vs Tottenham Hotspur (Away) — Won 3-2"), separate from and consistent with the user's own check of Tottenham's archive (thfcdb.com) and the earlier 3-2 figure — but this time for the correct date, not the misattributed 12 Apr 1975 fixture.

## New sources found

- **clarets-mad.co.uk** (`clarets-mad.co.uk/feat/edw4/programmes__season_197475_743043/index.shtml`) — full chronological Burnley match list, directly fetchable, not blocked. Fully resolves Burnley's fixtures for the window.
- **svenskafans.com** — Swedish-language fan site running a round-by-round ("Omgång N") recap series for the whole 1974-75 season, at minimum rounds 1 through 13+ (covers to 15 Oct) plus period summary articles (Oktoberprolog, Novemberepilog). Direct WebFetch is 403-blocked, but content is accessible via WebSearch snippets. Genuinely independent source, useful for cross-checking many clubs, not just the 4 targeted here.
- **11v11.com individual match-report pages** (URL pattern `/matches/<slug>/`, distinct from the blocked `/teams/.../tab/matches/` pages) — also 403 on direct WebFetch, but content surfaces through WebSearch.
- **bounder.friardale.co.uk/Results/1974.htm** — Chelsea-specific, but useful as a secondary cross-check for any club Chelsea played (confirms Burnley 21/27 Aug, and adds Tottenham 12 Oct: Chelsea 1–0 Tottenham away, and Coventry 24 Aug: Coventry City 1–3 Chelsea).

## Wayback Machine: dead end

Confirmed unusable — WebFetch refuses web.archive.org entirely regardless of snapshot availability ("Claude Code is unable to fetch from web.archive.org"), even when the Wayback availability API confirms a good snapshot exists (e.g. uptheclarets.com's results page has one, but it's unreachable).

## Remaining gaps

- **Sheffield United**: 2 new results found via svenskafans (24 Aug, away, lost 0–2 to Derby; 15 Oct, home, lost 1–2 to Derby, Francis Lee winner) — but their other fixtures in the window are still unsourced independently.
- **Coventry City**: now covered for 21/27 Aug (v Derby) and 31 Aug (v Burnley, away); other fixtures in the window still unsourced.
- **Tottenham Hotspur**: now covered for 21/28 Aug (v Man City), 5 Oct (v Burnley), and 12 Oct (v Chelsea, away); other fixtures in the window still unsourced.
- 11v11.com and svenskafans.com are both promising for filling these remaining gaps via further WebSearch-mediated queries (not direct fetch) if more research time is spent — worth trying per-club-per-date searches the same way the duplicate pairs were resolved here.
